---
name: Missing symbol
about: A parameter or function name that should resolve to standard notation but doesn't
title: "Missing symbol: <name>"
labels: enhancement
---

**Parameter or function name**

The name as it appears in code (e.g. `osmotic_pressure`).

**Expected symbol**

The notation you'd expect (e.g. `Π`), ideally the true Unicode glyph.

**Field it comes from**

The field whose literature uses this notation (e.g. physical
chemistry), with a citation or textbook reference if you have one to
hand.
